notes:
v4.6.22 — Per-bot lifetime tracking + AI return charts on the website

🐛 FIXED
• Crypto bot (and any other custom bot) showed '—' for every metric in the Overview account block. Root cause: _refresh_block did BOT_COLOR[side] which KeyError'd for non-built-in bots and got swallowed silently by the worker thread. Now uses .get() with fallback + wraps the whole refresh in try/except with logging.
• Period P/L now reflects the BOT's lifetime, not the Alpaca account's. Previously when the crypto bot took over an account previously used by the short bot, the Period P/L card showed the SHORT bot's old gains/losses. Now each active bot appends to its own *_lifetime.jsonl file in DATA_DIR and the Period P/L falls back to that bot-scoped series when the account history doesn't cover the period.

✨ NEW
• core.data.append_bot_snapshot / read_bot_snapshots — one JSONL file per bot, throttled to one snapshot per ~5 minutes, capped at 5000 rows on read.
• Website AI performance section above the download button. Two SVG line charts: BOT CREATION (returns grouped by which AI built the bot, META.ai_used) and BOT EXECUTION (returns grouped by which AI runs it). Source: aggregate of every cloud bot's *_lifetime.jsonl + each bot's META block. Auto-refreshes every 5 minutes.
• Top-bar 'DOWNLOAD' button on the website so visitors don't have to scroll.
• Main download button moved BELOW the AI charts to give them top billing.

Includes v4.6.21's deploy_server core/ sync + scheduler diagnostic logging.
